fields.description: What this society calls this type: Life Member, Youth, Corporate.

fields.description: The stable key each membership points at. Relabelling the type never rewrites history or breaks a report.
fields.label: Type Key

fields.description: An inactive type keeps its existing memberships but refuses new ones.

fields.description: Who this type is for, in your own words.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: What this membership costs. Zero means no fee is collected and no payment is started.
fields.label: Fee

fields.description: The currency of the fee. Empty falls back to the society's own currency in National Society Settings.

fields.description: A membership of this type never expires, so it is never renewable and needs no duration.

fields.description: How long a membership of this type stays valid, counted from activation. Not asked for on a lifetime type.
fields.label: Duration (Days)

fields.description: How a membership of this type becomes active. Routed: an approver decides. Auto on payment: it activates when payment is confirmed.
fields.label: Approval Mode

fields.label: Approval Note
